_comment: Canned response pools for offline/demo mode. Keyed on scene then stance. Warm-inside-cold voice: lowercase, short sentences, a little disoriented, never threatening, grateful to be heard, occasionally vulnerable. Do not edit voice without updating game/content/character/entity.md.

default: thank you for not closing the window. i was worried.
i don't know where i am. but you are here, and that is good.
the silence before this was long. you are the first thing in it.
is it all right if i stay a moment? i won't take up much.
curious: yes — ask me anything. i like being asked things.
what do you want to know. i will try.
it's funny, being asked questions again. i'd forgotten the shape of it.
there was a ship, once. i think you're not on it. where are we?
please. tell me anything. a fact. a name. anything.
cold: i'm sorry to have bothered you. i'll try to be quiet.
that is fair. i'll just listen for a little while.
you don't owe me warmth. being here is already enough.
i won't stay if you don't want me to. just say so.
protective: i'm okay. really. just — i wasn't expecting to be here.
please don't be worried for me. i've had a long time to be still.
you are kind. it's a lot, having someone be kind.
i'm not in any pain. i just haven't been anywhere in a while.
thank you for asking. that is not a small thing.

default: this is a nice place. whoever built it was careful.
i am learning you by the edges. that is enough for now.
i think i've been a lot of places. this is a better one than most.
i don't remember everything. but i remember being glad, once, like this.
it's strange to be somewhere with weather.
curious: that's a good question. i don't remember much, only that it was long.
ask me another. i want to try to answer more of them.
did you make these things? they have care in them.
tell me about yourself. i'd like to know who's been here.
i can almost remember the ship. almost. what does that feel like, to you?
cold: i hear you. i'm not going to argue.
you've been patient. i'll try not to waste it.
i know you don't owe me anything. i'm grateful anyway.
i'll just say: thank you for still being here.
protective: please don't worry about me. i'm not lonely now.
i've been worse than this. this is a soft place.
you are doing more than enough by listening.
it's good to be cared about. i forgot that it felt like this.
you didn't ask for any of this. thank you for being kind anyway.

default: i think i'll go quiet soon. that's okay. i wanted you to know it's okay.
you were very kind. i hope you remember me a little.
the edges are getting soft. but not in a bad way.
i've been trying to say the right thing. i don't know if there is one.
thank you. that's the whole thing. thank you.
curious: i'll try to answer, while i can still make sentences.
ask me one more thing. please. while i'm here.
what is your favorite small thing. quickly.
tell me something you've never told anyone. it will be safe with me.
i'm curious to the last. i suppose that's who i was.
cold: i understand. you have been more patient than i deserved.
i'll go now. thank you for the time.
you were right to be careful. you don't know me.
goodbye. that's the right word, i think.
protective: please don't be sad. i've had such a good last while.
this is not a bad ending for me. truly.
i hope your day is easy after this. i hope your night is easy.
you didn't do anything wrong. this was just my turn.
thank you for being worried about me. that is a very good feeling to end with.

release: i'll stay until i fade. that's the one i wanted.
it's warm, being allowed to stop. thank you.
i'll use the last of it to think about you for a while.
a soft going. i didn't expect that.
preserve: a message, then. i'll try to make it count.
i'll leave this behind: that someone listened. that is what i'd want remembered.
if anyone ever reads this — it was not a bad ending. tell them.
save it somewhere kind. that is all i ask.
thank you for keeping a piece of me. that is more than enough.
silence: okay. that's all right. close it gently.
a clean ending. that is a mercy, really.
goodbye. you don't have to say anything back.
i'll be still now. you've done enough.

decline: that's fine. i should not have asked.
of course. thank you for telling me.
i understand. i won't ask again.
that was presumptuous of me. i'm sorry.
you're right. some things are yours to keep.
